test_nested_element: test the xml_tools.nested_element function creates nested XML elements to a specified depth
test_parse_xml: test the xml_tools.parse function reads XML from a file-like object and returns an etree element
test_find_element: test the xml_tools.find_element function locates an XML element by tag and name attribute
test_find_element_raises: test the xml_tools.find_element function raises ValueError when no matching element is found
test_tostring_pretty_print: test the xml_tools.parse output can be pretty printed with etree.tostring
